Read-only review (Opus). Not built here.

Verdict: Needs changes before merge.

The logic is correct. The pinning tests do not cover two of the three cases of the new rule. This PR is under the safety floor, so each branch of a feed rating must have a pin.

## Blockers

1. `crates/app/tests/hole_feed_rating.rs:259-298` - the new test pins only one case: the running feed is lower than the material row. Two cases have no pin:
   - **Row lower.** The document material and the stock material are the same, and the user raises the running feed above the named row (for example row 115, running 200). The rating must stay at the row (115). An op at 200 must be refused at the post, and a new Drill op must seed 115. If `rated_feed` used `max` or the running feed alone, the posted feed would go up, and no test would fail. Before this PR the existing tests ran with the running feed equal to the row, so they do not catch this.
   - **Unchanged control.** The setup's stock states a material that is not the document material (`set_stock_material`), and the running feed is lower than that material's row. The rating must stay at the row of the stock material: no refusal and no lower seed. This is the `material != document` branch at `crates/app/src/operation/feed_rating.rs:55`. The PR body names it under "Not exercised".

   Add the two cases. They can be extra steps in the new MCP test or a small unit test of `operation::feed_rating::rated_feed` in `crates/app/tests/` (it is `pub`). Then run the quick gate again on the new head and name the tests in the body.

## Checked, no finding

- Merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` with the branch is clean.
- Direction of change: `rated_feed` (`feed_rating.rs:50-60`) gives `min(row, running)` only when the material in force is the document material. In all other paths it gives the same value as before. Thus the rating never goes up, and no refusal that fired before is relaxed. The post clause `problems` and the seed paths (`seed_feed_for_tool`, `retargeted_params` from `EditOperationLinks`) use the same function, so a seeded feed passes its own check.
- `SetStockMaterial` does not call `feed_rating::seed_into`. All callers of `rated_feed`, `seed_into` and `retargeted_params` are updated.
- `material == document` when the two are `None`: the `Unknown` row is in force. `follow_running` moves that row with the running feed, so the minimum is the same value in normal use.
- Zero, NaN or negative feeds: a running feed that is not usable does not lower the rating. A row feed that is not usable now gives the running feed as the rating, where before there was no rating. That is stricter, not looser (see note 1).
- Units: the row feed and the running feed are the same `Tool` unit. The message converts with `units::feed`, as before.
- Tapping: `judged_feed` still skips `Tap`, `FloatingTap` and `Auto` with a tap tool, so a pitch-tied feed is not judged. The Thread op (thread milling) feed is an edge feed, not a pitch feed, and its plunge feed is still held to the rating.
- Goldens: no `.nc`, `.cl` or `.camproj` file changes.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests. File lengths: `feed_rating.rs` 156, `cutting_rows.rs` 178, `edit.rs` 345, `hole_feed_rating.rs` 298 lines.
- Test placement: `crates/app/tests/` imports `camcraft_app` items. The file's Gate map already names `app::operation::feed_rating` and `app::cutting_rows`.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/2724-hole-feed-running-limit.md` is present, with what was chosen, why, and what was dropped.
- Body: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2724`, and the quick gate on head 174da2b81 (the current head) with the pin named.

## Notes

1. A project saved before this PR can now be refused at the post if a tool's running feed is lower than its named row for the document material. The refusal names the op and the limit, and the stored values do not change. This agrees with the decision entry. You can add one sentence about it to the `Changelog:` line.
2. A tool row with a feed that is zero or not finite now gives the running feed as the seed of a new Drill or Thread op. Before, the op kept its default feed. This is the same law as the no-row path, but no test covers it.

Addressed (head b60839ed0dd14bafd4e86d594d00b15f6d1e2615).

Blocker 1 (two cases with no pin). The fix adds two MCP tests in `crates/app/tests/hole_feed_rating.rs`. No production code changed.
- Row lower: `a_running_feed_raised_above_the_material_row_keeps_the_row_rating`. The steel row is 115 and the running feed is 200. The op at 200 is refused at the post with `D: feeds 200 mm/min, above the 115 mm/min`. A new Drill op seeds 115 / 115. A mutation run with `max` in `rated_feed` makes this test fail. The source was put back after the run. The running feed alone gives the same 200, so that rule also fails the test.
- Unchanged control: `a_stock_material_other_than_the_document_is_rated_by_its_own_row`. The document is mild steel, the stock is brass (row 150), and the running feed is 80. The op at 150 passes `verify`. A new Drill op seeds 150 / 150. An op at 160 is refused against 150. A mutation run that applies the running feed for each material makes this test fail. The source was put back after the run.

Note 1 (old projects). The `Changelog:` line now says that a project saved before this change can be refused at its next post, and that the stored feeds do not change.

Note 2 (row feed zero or not finite). The new unit test `a_row_feed_that_is_not_usable_gives_the_running_feed` calls `rated_feed` with a row feed of 0, NaN, infinity and -5. Each gives the running feed (90).

The branch also has a merge of `origin/main` (20c81cbc1). The merge had no conflicts.

Gate on the new head:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test hole_feed_rating --test tool_cutting_rows --test cutting_unknown_row --test lathe_workholding_kinds --locked`: 7 + 11 + 9 + 10 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --locked`: 287 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: clean.

The PR stays a draft. The `needs-rework` label stays for the re-review.

Read-only delta review (Opus). Not built here.

Verdict for the whole PR at this head: Ready to merge.

This verdict replaces the "Needs changes" verdict on head 174da2b81. The change request of that review is withdrawn. Its one blocker has a pin now.

Scope: the commits after 174da2b81 only.

Delta classes:
- 4b4afcd85 (tests): NEW CODE. `git diff 174da2b81 4b4afcd85` changes only `crates/app/tests/hole_feed_rating.rs` (+75, 0 lines removed). No production code changed. No existing assert changed.
- b60839ed0 (merge of `origin/main` at 20c81cbc1): SAME. `git show --remerge-diff b60839ed0` is empty.

Trial merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/issue/2724-hole-feed-running-limit` is clean against the current main 13f26da99 (tree 94fba1405). Main moved one merge (#2939) after the gated merge. This PR does not touch those files.

The new tests, read against `rated_feed` in `crates/app/src/operation/feed_rating.rs`:
- `a_running_feed_raised_above_the_material_row_keeps_the_row_rating`: row 115, running feed 200, no stock material, so `stock_material::in_force` gives the document material. The `min` gives 115. The test asserts `verify` `ok: false`, the post refusal text `D: feeds 200 mm/min, above the 115 mm/min`, no output file, and a new Drill op seeded 115 / 115. A rule with `max`, or with the running feed alone, gives 200. Then the op posts and the seed is 200, so the test fails. This closes the blocker for the row-lower case.
- `a_stock_material_other_than_the_document_is_rated_by_its_own_row`: document mild steel, stock brass (row 150), running feed 80. The material is not the document material, so the running feed is not a limit and the rating is 150. The test asserts `verify` `ok: true` at 150, a seed of 150 / 150, and a refusal against 150 at 160. A rule that always takes the lower value gives 80, and the test fails. This is the unchanged control.
- `a_row_feed_that_is_not_usable_gives_the_running_feed`: calls `rated_feed` with a row feed of 0, NaN, infinity and -5. Each case gives `Some(90.0)`, the running feed. This agrees with the `usable` filter and the `(r, t) => r.or(t)` arm. It closes review note 2.

Other checks:
- The test file has 373 lines (limit about 400).
- The "Addressed" comment reports the gate on the merged tree: `hole_feed_rating` 7 passed, `tool_cutting_rows` 11, `cutting_unknown_row` 9, `lathe_workholding_kinds` 10 (1 ignored, as on main), the app lib tests 287 passed, clippy clean.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line. It now says that an older project can be refused at its next post and that the stored feeds do not change. The body ends with the closing line for issue 2724.

No blockers. No new notes.
